technical-summary: rad0031 adds two-shot phase timelines to R4D_AR_TIMELINE; rad0032 adds ts_pieces, ts_pieces_min, ts_fuse and ts_duplex tune-pin axes for the three-rank two-shot all-reduce; rad0033 adds ts_once (reduced shard written once in host scratch). qwen27b-tp3 and qwen27b-tp3-int8 pin nblocks=4,nthreads=256,ts_pieces=4,ts_fuse=1,ts_once=1,ts_duplex=1. Bit-identical logprobs; 2x ABBA: TTFT 2048 -24% int8 / -27% MXFP4, 8 streams +13.9% / +16.7%; int8 stress 12/12 clean.
user-summary-candidate: Three-GPU 27B layouts reach first token about a quarter faster and serve 14-17% more tokens at 8 streams, with identical output, from a faster all-reduce.
